corrected_text: Agello (a69121286e) starts a chat reply only when maxNumTokens minus the tokens the cache will hold after the message's prefill (counted exactly for text) and a 64-token margin leaves at least 96 tokens, and caps the reply at that room (ToolBudget.plan's share of it when tools are offered). Its maxNumTokens is always the positions LiteRT-LM allocates (ContextBudget.allocatedPositions: 32,000 for a request of 32,003 or more with the published file, the 64K window of 12 GB devices included), and the window is no longer a setting, so with exact counts a send's prefill has at least its input plus 160 positions free, more than the at most input + 127 that E4B's prefill_128 runs need, and a reply without tool calls stops decoding 64 positions before the end of the window plus at most one MTP round's tokens. At Agello 93122b6 (2026-10-15) a manual KV-cache size of 32,768 (the Stepper's top) allocated only 32,000 positions while the budget counted 32,768, so the margin didn't hold.
note: Re-pin 2026-11-17, reconciliation r3, at Agello HEAD a69121286e. Margin arithmetic unchanged: room = w - used - 64 >= 96 with used = cached + message tokens (tokensAfterPrefill, exact for text), so free positions >= input + 160 > input + 127. New: resolve() passes every request, override included, through allocatedPositions (exportWindow 32,003 -> (32003-1)/256*256 = 32,000; 65,536 -> 32,000), and DeviceProfile (71-89) makes the window a fixed 16K or 64K, no longer a setting (2026-11-02), so the 32,768 caveat is history (AdvancedSettingsView and InferencePlanner at 93122b6 kept as its sources); the Advanced screen was removed on 2026-11-11. Dropped 'so it stays clear of the positions an MTP round can reach past the end': since 3fa97211 no round runs past the end (X-GAP-010). The magic-number source is the ledger's, unchanged.
